verdict.rationale: Typesense is a search engine that receives data and answers queries. It is not an agent or tool-using client, so plugging MCP servers into it to consume their tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows Typesense Cloud offers its own MCP server for agents to connect to (typesense-docs-43, typesense-docs-53). That is the server-side role and does not count toward this MCP-client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
